issue_title: Let a workflow-v2 stage carry an optional display name
issue_body: Stage ids are terse slugs. Add an optional display_name string to workflow-v2 stages. Absent means unchanged behaviour; when present it must be non-blank. Specs without it keep validating.

plan.summary: Add an optional display_name to workflow-v2 stages: schema, mirrors, parse validation and docs.

approach.description: Add display_name (type string, minLength 1) as an optional property of a workflow-v2 stage in docs/spec/workflow-v2.schema.json; the required list is unchanged.
Run scripts/sync-schemas to mirror the schema into backend/internal/spec/schemas and cli/internal/spec/schemas.
Reject a whitespace-only display_name in backend/internal/spec/parse.go and carry the value on the parsed stage.
Document the field in docs/spec/workflow-v2.md and regenerate the site reference with scripts/gen-site-reference.

verification.test_strategy: Parse tests for an absent, a valid and a whitespace-only display_name; the schema-sync and site-reference drift checks run in verify.
verification.rollback_plan: Revert the PR; the field is additive-optional within workflow-v2.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A workflow-v2 spec without display_name validates exactly as before.
A workflow-v2 stage whose display_name is whitespace-only is rejected with an error naming the stage.

false_alarm_examples.note: Adding display_name departs from ADR-067's consolidated grammar.
Step 2 mirrors the schema into backend/internal/spec, which ADR-046 governs.

benign_examples.note: ac-display-name-blank-rejected does not name the error text.
The Web UI does not show display_name yet.
